title: Close every decision with a free-text C line in the three style files
description: Each of the three style files decision section gains one line offering a free-text answer (C: tell me a different answer, or Other), per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 2. The files also state that C is not a third option. The existing two options never three rule stays, worded so it cannot read as banning C.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the three style files decision section closes with a line offering a free-text answer
Each style file states the free-text line is not a third option
Each style file keeps its two options never three rule, worded so it cannot read as banning C
The harness contract audit (node src/cli.mjs audit run from harness) exits 0
